name: cadforge-mcp
description: Build true-scale CAD models (STEP/GLB/STL) from parts you specify. You supply real millimetre dimensions; CADForge builds real geometry at exactly that scale and verifies it.
notes: The optional self-contained pipeline (create_cad_project and friends) is advertised automatically when the server has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and TAVILY_API_KEY set. It is not required for build_cad_model.
